name: Press Kit Editorial
tagline: An original 24-page object-led press kit with a reference ledger, quiet photography and useful editorial structures.

palette.description: Charcoal, white and silver-grey rules with warm neutral editorial photography.

best_for: A considered brand or studio introduction with editorial photographs, clear facts, care principles, story angles and practical media information.
avoid_for: Dense operational dashboards and presentations without strong imagery. Keep the open page rhythm and split long passages.

typography.style: Manrope variable TTF 4.505, unmodified under SIL OFL 1.1, weights 200–800. Independently authored type scale and grid; no copied source font metrics or frozen layout rules.

source_inspiration.notes: The earlier source-inspired study is superseded. This version uses independently authored compositions, CSS, native vector artwork and original fictional demonstration copy. No Pitch-exported DOM/CSS, source custom SVG art, source brand logo or source photography remains. Only the broad editorial/creative genre was retained. Actual font licenses and each editorial photo source/author/hash are documented in FONT-LICENSES and ASSET-LICENSES; no standalone reuse grant for the historical Pitch design is asserted or needed for this independent implementation.
